peak_basis: One p300c ASIC: 120 cores, 4096 ops/cycle, 1.35GHz, HiFi4 /4; 512GB/s. Official p300/QuietBox2 specs and tt-perf-report ArchitectureSpec.
device_window_basis: FW end minus FW start across ALL layer ops, including gaps. Decode is mean of 128 complete per-replay windows; gaps between separate replays excluded.
assumptions: BF16 weights/activations/cache, HiFi4; dense active work. Useful FLOPs count all linear projections and causal QK/PV, omit small elementwise work. Estimated DRAM: physical operand/output bytes for every ordinary DRAM op once, active KV once, tile cache updates and page metadata; L1 operands excluded. Includes tile padding, excludes redundant per-core reads and cache reuse. BinaryNg hash-cached prefill shapes are replaced by actual decode B<=32 residual/MLP and KV-norm geometry. Weight reference bytes are informational and not added twice. Percentages are estimates, not counters.
